newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils mostly lower on signs rally overdone.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils mostly lower on signs rally overdone.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices were mostly lower on Tuesday on signs yesterday's rally in Chicago was overdone.
"It's the same old story every year, Chicago overreacts to changes in the weather and at first people here fall for it," said one.
"Project "A" has come down and we are getting reports of rain in the growing areas," said another.
Palm oil production, stocks and export data released by the Malaysian Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) were seen as neutral.
PORLA put end-June output at 787.807 tonnes against 792,540 tonnes at end-May, down 0.60 percent.
Stocks at end-June were 786,123 tonnes against 712,289 tonnes, a rise of 10.37 percent, while exports were running at 612,124 tonnes against 633,507 in May.
Higher palm oil prices at the close in Malaysia following export figures from Malaysian cargo surveyor SGS had no impact on prices in Europe.
SGS put exports between July 1-15 at 307,536 tonnes against 290,935 tonnes during the same period in May.
At midday crude palm oil cif Europe was $2.50 down to unchanged after Sep traded at $507.50 a tonne cif.
Among products RBD oil was unchanged to $2.50 lower while olein was $2.50 to $5 down.
Dated July RBD palm oil fetched $445 a tonne for July, $490 for Aug and $487.50 for Oct/Dec while $527.50 was paid for Aug/Sep olein.
Coconut oil sellers were $5 to $10 up with palmkernel oil $2.50 higher in neglected markets.
Dutch soy oil offers were unchanged from the opening at one guilders down while rape oil was unchanged. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
